Features

Everything you need to code

📂

Real Filesystem

Open any folder on your machine. All edits save directly to disk — no export needed.

🎨

Syntax Highlighting

HTML, CSS, JS, TS, Python, C/C++, Java, Rust, Go, PHP, Ruby, Shell, JSON, XML, Markdown and more.

⚡

Auto-save

Every keystroke is saved after 350ms. Never lose work again.

🤖

AI Generation

Generate code with Claude AI. The prompt adapts to whichever file type is active.

🌐

Live HTML Preview

See your HTML/CSS rendered in real-time. Open in a full browser tab with one click.

✏️

Smart Autocomplete

HTML tags & attributes, CSS properties, JS/Python/C++ snippets — all with Tab to insert.

👁

File Watcher

External changes to your directory are detected and the file tree refreshes automatically.

🗂

File Manager

Create, rename, delete files and folders directly from the sidebar. Right-click for context menu.

Installation

Get started in seconds

1

Download the .deb file

Click the Linux button above to download fadan-code_1.0.0_amd64.deb

2

Install via terminal

Open a terminal and run:

sudo dpkg -i fadan-code_1.0.0_amd64.deb
3

Launch

Find Fadan Code in your app launcher, or run:

fadan-code
1

Download the installer

Click the Windows button above to download fadan-code Setup 1.0.0.exe

2

Run the installer

Double-click the .exe and follow the setup wizard. Windows may show a SmartScreen warning — click More info → Run anyway.

3

Launch

Find Fadan Code in the Start menu or on your Desktop.

1

Download the .dmg file

Click the macOS button above to download Fadan.Code-1.0.0-arm64.dmg

2

Open the installer

Double-click the .dmg file, then drag Fadan Code into your Applications folder.

3

Launch

Open Fadan Code from your Applications folder or Spotlight search. If macOS blocks it, go to System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway.
